description: This file defines the GeneralException class, a custom exception used in the OFBiz framework, supporting nested exceptions and message lists.

classes.name: GeneralException
classes.description: A custom exception class in the OFBiz framework that supports nested exceptions, message lists, and various constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: checkException
methods.description: Static method to check and rethrow a Throwable as a GeneralException or its subclass.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns a detailed message including nested exception message if present.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages associated with the exception.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage
methods.description: Returns the message without including nested exception details.

methods.name: getNested
methods.description: Returns the nested cause of the exception if any.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to standard error or specified stream/writer.
